about: Noise budgets per task and language. Fixed here before a task's first authoring round and frozen from then on; check_task.py budgets enforces it from git history, and check 10 requires each task's private task.json to carry the same budget.

b01-modbus-fc17.deviation: budget fitted after authoring: the C budget moved from 20..50 to 30..150 to 150..250 during authoring, so b01-C noise is not a pre-registered quantity. The Rust budget was set before Rust authoring and did not move.
